atom_text: Lithium suppressed PTZ-induced seizures in the +/+ (wild-type) genotype (Fig. 7d)
locator: Fig 7d top panel (+/+), image read of 40478_2020_883_Fig7_HTML.jpg and the _assets PNG: PTZ N=12 (red) vs PTZ+LiCl N=8 (blue), bracket marked **** ; mouse; N=animals (Fig 7 legend does not define N); LiCl 60 mg/kg i.p. x3 within 1 h before PTZ 30 mg/kg (Methods, Induction of seizure)
note: Statistical mark is in the image only; legend defines only n.s. and *** (not ****), Methods name one-way ANOVA and the unit of analysis for the time-course is not stated. Wild-type PTZ scores are low (peak about 1.2 Racine units, stage 1 = behavioral arrest/vibrissae twitching, i.e. below overt seizure stage 3+), and the text calls them behavior changes; so the effect is a reduction of a low score, not suppression of tonic-clonic seizures.
